description: Multi-location Traffic Flow Dataset: Stockton and Oakland California is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Martin Esugo. This dataset supports the research detailed in "A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach with GEH-based Loss Function and Evaluation Metric for Multi-location Traffic Flow Forecasting" containing traffic flow measurements from Stockton and Oakland, California. The dataset is organized into four sub-folders: 'Oakland-raw', 'Oakland-processed', 'Stockton-raw', and 'Stockton-processed'. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 141292394 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
